description: Test class for ConnectionStatusMessageMapper, validating mapping behavior with various inputs and configurations.

classes.name: ConnectionStatusMessageMapperTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ConnectionStatusMessageMapper, testing various mapping scenarios, header parsing, configuration validation, and external message handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, sets up valid headers, configuration properties, and mapper configuration.

methods.name: doForwardMapWithValidUseCase
methods.description: Tests standard mapping of a valid external message, verifying proper conversion into signals with correct feature properties.

methods.name: doForwardMapWithValidUseCaseTtdZero
methods.description: Tests mapping when TTD (time-to-delta) is zero, expecting a property with current creation time.

methods.name: doForwardMapWithValidUseCaseTtdMinusOne
methods.description: Tests mapping when TTD is -1, expecting the feature's ready-until property to be set to a distant future timestamp.

methods.name: doForwardMapWithMissingHeaderTTD
methods.description: Validates behavior when TTD header is missing, expecting an empty mapping result.

methods.name: doForwardMapWithMissingHeaderCreationTime
methods.description: Validates behavior when creation time header is missing, expecting an empty mapping result.

methods.name: doForwardMapWithMissingHeader
methods.description: Tests missing header scenario with placeholder thing id, expecting no mapping result.

methods.name: doForwardMapWithInvalidHeaderTTD
methods.description: Tests invalid TTD value, expecting no mapping result.

methods.name: doForwardMapWithInvalidHeaderCreationTime
methods.description: Tests invalid creation time, expecting no mapping result.

methods.name: doForwardMapWithInvalidTTDValue
methods.description: Tests a negative TTD value that is out of valid range, expecting no mapping result.

methods.name: doForwardMappingContextWithoutFeatureId
methods.description: Tests default feature ID assignment when configuration does not specify a feature ID.

methods.name: doForwardMappingContextWithIndividualFeatureId
methods.description: Verifies behavior when configuration specifies a custom feature ID.

methods.name: doForwardMappingContextWithoutThingId
methods.description: Ensures exception is thrown if no thing id configuration is provided.

methods.name: doForwardMappingContextWithWrongThingId
methods.description: Tests behavior when configured thing ID is invalid, expecting a runtime exception.

methods.name: doForwardMappingContextWithThingIdMapping
methods.description: Tests proper substitution of placeholder in thing ID with header value, resulting in correct topic path.

methods.name: doForwardMappingContextWithWrongThingIdMapping
methods.description: Tests failure when placeholder in thing ID cannot be mapped from headers, expecting empty result.
